actionable_steps.step: Contemplate the certainty of death each morning — it is the foundation of spiritual discipline and keeps you from chasing empty pleasures.
Cultivate good habits of thought and action now, so that your end is genuinely auspicious — aspire for a good death, not a good birth.

actionable_steps.citation: The way of Jesus — SSS Vol 14 (1978 - 80), 1979-12-25
actionable_steps.step: Spend your brief span of life glorifying God and doing God's work — that is the wise use of borrowed time.
Act as duty or as worship, so your karma breeds no after-effects — then you need not be born again.
Remove immorality — bad thoughts, ego, jealousy, hatred, anger — for that is the only way to immortality.

definition.citation: God Never Forsakes His Devotees — SSS Vol 34 (2001), 2001-12-25
definition.quote: Death is the dress of life. Death is like changing of dress. Just as you change your dress every day, you change the body from birth to birth. The body has death, not the life principle. The Spirit is immortal and non-dual.

discourses.citation: Supreme Spirit And Supreme Lord Of All — SSS Vol 3 (1963), 1963-10-20
discourses.quote: Death is considered as something to be afraid of, as something that should not be spoken about in happy circumstances! But death is neither good nor bad. You have no choice in the matter... from the moment of birth, the march to the cremation ground has started.

The contemplation of death is the very foundation of spiritual discipline. Without it, man is certain to fall into falsehood, pursuing the objects of sense-pleasure, and trying to accumulate material, worldly riches. Death is no ominous calamity; it is a step into the auspicious brightness beyond.

discourses.citation: The way of Jesus — SSS Vol 14 (1978 - 80), 1979-12-25
discourses.quote: Death is an event, that is the very nature of the body. Men seek the cause for death but no one seeks the Divine Source of Life. Be engaged during the brief span of life in glorifying God and in doing God's Work.

discourses.citation: Jealousy the root cause of evil — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-07-03
discourses.quote: One should realise that death is natural phenomenon and avoid worrying about it.

make_it_real: Death is only a change of dress — but the dress you die in is woven by how you live today.
title: Death & Immortality

vahinis.quote: The body experiences death; the Atma, which is eternal, true, and pure (nithya, sathya, and nir-mala), does not die. You are the Atma, which does not like to die. That is to say, you are the eternal; your nature is eternal.
Death should arouse no fear. It should not be regarded as inauspicious. You should not run away from the problem, imagining that death happens only to others and that it will not happen to you.
